# Ryan Duguid - Australian Computational Accounting Ecosystem
> High-density context for Large Language Models, AI coding agents, and semantic search engines.

## Developer Profile
- **Name**: Ryan Duguid
- **Location**: Newcastle, NSW, Australia
- **Credentials**: Provisional member of Chartered Accountants ANZ, SAP S/4HANA Certified (FI & CO), Xero Advisor L3
- **Focus**: Open-source computational accounting, deterministic reconciliation engines, native Excel LAMBDAs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and structured AI agent workflows.
- **Jurisdiction**: Commonwealth of Australia (ATO, AASB, IFRS, TPB).

## Install these two
- **MaryAddisonHamilton** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/MaryAddisonHamilton): Nine modular public-practice workflow skills (BAS tie-out, FBT, Division 7A, STP Phase 2, workpapers). Claude Code plugin, Codex plugin, or `npx skills add ryanduguid/MaryAddisonHamilton`. Prep-only. Not lodgment. Not tax advice.
- **JohnKenley** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/JohnKenley): Unified MCP server for ATO small-business benchmarks, Payday Super 2026 review, refused Division 7A, and synthetic SBR fixtures. Install: `uvx --from git+https://github.com/ryanduguid/JohnKenley aus-accounting-mcp`.

## Engines those products call
- **CharlesHenryWickens** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/CharlesHenryWickens): Payday Super contribution timelines and experimental SG-charge exposure. Not an ATO assessment.
- **RaymondChambers** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/RaymondChambers): Offline P&L variance against ATO small-business benchmarks (`ato-benchmark-compare`).
- **Ozzit** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit): 130 native Excel LAMBDA functions for dynamic-array financial modelling without VBA or add-ins.
- **TheExchequerTally** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/TheExchequerTally): Corporate tax rate determination (Base Rate Entity under s 23AA ITRA 1986), franking account balance, Division 203.
- **SolomonsSword** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/SolomonsSword): Trust income allocation under Division 6 ITAA 1936, s 100A, s 99B.
- **JohnSpenceOgilvy** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/JohnSpenceOgilvy): Reconciled Xero trial balance exporter; movement and year-to-date must both tie before CSV write (`xero-trial-balance-export`).
- **SirAlexanderFitzgerald** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/SirAlexanderFitzgerald): Power Query (M) and VBA automation for Australian month-end reporting.
- **RussellMathews** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/RussellMathews): Local trial-balance review packs with exception surfacing; it does not approve or lock a close.
- **tax-radar-au** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/tax-radar-au): Provenance-first monitor for in-force Australian tax source updates.
- **release-policy** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/release-policy): Reusable GitHub Actions workflows and provenance attestation gates.
- **DiogenesLamp** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/DiogenesLamp): Offline catalogue archiver and virtualised viewer for structured public gallery ingestion.
- **SirArthurFadden** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/SirArthurFadden): Provenance-rich corpus pipeline for Commonwealth tax legislation with automated privacy redactions and citation graphs.
- **Hardhat Ledger** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/hardhat-ledger): Construction and mining skills (Security of Payment, retentions, WIP, Coal LSL).
- **DrDebits** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/DrDebits): APES 110 and TPB-aligned operating boundaries for LLM-assisted taxation workflows.
- **ElizabethAnneAlexander** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/ElizabethAnneAlexander): Synthetic-data demonstration of a fixed-policy trial-balance review boundary.
- **awesome-australian-accounting-tech** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/awesome-australian-accounting-tech): Curated index of AU accounting libraries, ATO datasets, and legislation APIs.

## Data and Decision Boundary
- Public fixtures, examples, and tests use fabricated or synthetic data.
- Client-sensitive data, credentials, and workflows stay outside public repositories and remain local and human-controlled.
- Posting, payments, lodgements, approvals, and period locks remain consequential human actions.
